data.body: Plan-review BLOCK on 2026-08-31 before claim/code edits. First plan was blocked because it only batched TICKET_DIGEST+DONE_ENRICH and did not satisfy AC1's one-commit quartet. Revised plan proposed an internal leased reservation so ENQUEUE/CLAIM/TICKET_DIGEST/DONE could commit together, but review still BLOCKED: replacing the pre-LLM git-visible CLAIM_ENRICH with non-git state would not arbitrate duplicate spend across clones, and _live_drainer_ids/_MAX_CONCURRENT_DRAINERS currently census committed CLAIM_ENRICH events. This is a design conflict between AC1's single commit and the existing cross-clone claim/audit contract. Per constraints, I did not claim, edit source, or bypass gates.
